title: Infinite Canons: Maximally Self-Similar Melodic Lines and Canons with Infinite Solutions
summary: Infinite Canons is an ongoing series of canons with infinite solutions. More specifically, each canon is based on a melodic line that can be combined in any number of voices, at any tempo ratios (rational or irrational), and with each voice moving either forward or in retrograde inversion, while maintaining harmonic consistency.
